items.name: Heavy cargo transport
items.card: Machinery, structures and industrial volumes by road, nationwide and cross-border.
items.imageAlt: Lowbed trailer hauling an excavator along an Andean highway

meta.title: Heavy Cargo Transport in Peru and the Andean Community | Tránsito Nacional
meta.description: Heavy cargo road transport in Peru, Ecuador and Colombia: machinery, structures and industrial volumes with insurance included and 24/7 monitoring.

items.lead: We move machinery, steel structures, coils, containers and industrial volumes by road, within Peru and across to Ecuador and Colombia.
includes: The right unit for the load: lowbed, flatbed or box truck
Route planning with weight and height restrictions
Cargo verification at origin before dispatching the unit
Insurance policy from loading to unloading
Permanent monitoring and progress reports
Permit coordination when the route requires it
body: Every heavy load has its own physics: center of gravity, lifting points, lashing tolerances. Before assigning the unit we study the real weight, dimensions and route, and only then confirm the equipment and the rate.
During the trip, the unit reports its position and we keep you informed at every milestone. If anything changes on the road, you hear it from us first.

faq.q: What kinds of units do you run for heavy cargo?
faq.a: Lowbeds, cradle beds, flatbeds and box trucks, depending on the weight, dimensions and route of your load.

faq.q: Do you cover mining routes or hard-to-reach areas?
faq.a: Yes. We assess the route during planning and assign units and drivers experienced in high altitude and gravel roads.

items.card: Controlled, logged cold chain for food, agro and pharma.
items.imageAlt: Refrigerated truck loading at a cold storage dock at night

meta.title: Refrigerated Cargo and Cold Chain Transport | Tránsito Nacional
meta.description: Refrigerated transport in Peru, Ecuador and Colombia with controlled, logged temperature for food, agribusiness and pharma. Get a quote today.

items.lead: Seafood products at low temperatures, fresh and frozen food, agro exports and pharmaceutical products with temperature controlled end to end.
includes: Refrigerated units with configurable temperature ranges
Temperature logging throughout the journey
Cleaning and safety protocols per product type
Seal and stowage verification at origin
Cargo insurance covering sensitive goods
Border priority for perishable products
body: In cold chain, the enemy is time out of range. We configure the unit for your product and log the temperature during the whole trip.
We work with seafood exporters, agro exporters and distributors who cannot afford a rejection at destination: every refrigerated trip is planned with margin.

faq.q: What temperature ranges do you handle?
faq.a: From deep frozen to chilled and ventilated. The unit is configured to your product's technical sheet.

faq.q: Can I see the temperature during the trip?
faq.a: Yes. We share the temperature logs during transit.

items.name: Integrated logistics
items.card: We plan your full operation: transport, warehousing, insurance and customs under one contract.

meta.title: Integrated Logistics for Your Cargo | Tránsito Nacional
meta.description: Integrated logistics operator in the Andean Community: planning, transport, warehousing, insurance and customs under a single accountable partner.

items.lead: A single accountable partner for your whole operation: service planning, transport, warehousing, cargo insurance and customs.
includes: Service planning tailored to your operation
National and international road transport
Warehousing to match your operation flow
End-to-end cargo insurance
Customs management at CAN borders
One point of contact and one invoice
body: Coordinating transport, warehousing, insurance and customs separately multiplies emails, blame and cost overruns. We integrate the pieces and answer for the complete result.
You define what your cargo needs; we build the operation, run it and report back through a single contact.

faq.q: Do you handle recurring operations or only one-off shipments?
faq.a: Both. For recurring flows we set up a program with fixed rates and windows; for one-off shipments we quote same day.

faq.q: What do I gain versus hiring each service separately?
faq.a: One accountable partner, less internal management and an integrated rate. If something fails, there are no third parties to chase: we answer.

Covered, guarded storage
Cargo consolidation and deconsolidation
Reported, traceable inventory
Dispatch coordinated with our transport network
body: The right warehouse turns several small shipments into one efficient operation. We consolidate your goods, guard them and dispatch them in the window your client demands.
With warehousing and transport under one operator, your cargo does not wait: it flows.

faq.q: Can I store for short periods?
faq.a: Yes. We quote for the actual time stored, from days to monthly contracts.
Yes, coverage extends to warehouse dwell time when you contract the integrated service.

items.name: Cargo insurance
items.card: We arrange the policy covering your goods. The premium is quoted separately from the freight.
items.imageAlt: Inspector in a hard hat checking cargo lashing on a flatbed

meta.title: Door-to-Door Cargo Insurance | Tránsito Nacional
meta.description: End-to-end cargo insurance for national and international transport. We arrange the policy; the premium is quoted separately and paid by the client.

items.lead: We arrange the policy covering your goods from loading until unloading at destination. The premium is quoted separately from the freight and is paid by the client.
includes: End-to-end coverage: loading, transit and unloading
Policy matching the declared value of your goods
Premium quoted separately from freight, paid by the client
National and international coverage across the CAN
Guidance to declare value correctly
Full claim management, should one occur
body: A cheap freight rate without coverage becomes expensive the day something goes wrong. That is why we arrange the policy alongside your service and hand you the certificate before the unit departs.

The insurance premium is not included in the freight rate: it is quoted separately based on the declared value and type of goods, and it is covered by the client. That way you know exactly what you pay for transport and what for coverage.

faq.q: Is insurance included in the freight rate?
faq.a: No. The policy is quoted separately and is a client cost. The premium depends on the declared value and type of goods, and we detail it alongside the transport proposal.

faq.q: What happens if there is a claim?
faq.a: We manage the entire process with the insurer and keep you informed until the case is closed.

items.name: Customs clearance
items.card: Documentation and customs solved so you cross borders without delays.
items.imageAlt: Cargo trucks queued at an Andean border crossing at dawn

meta.title: Customs Clearance and CAN Cross-Border Transport | Tránsito Nacional
meta.description: Customs management for road transport between Peru, Ecuador and Colombia: CPIC, MCI and Andean Community documentation without border delays.

items.lead: We prepare and manage international trade and transport documentation so your cargo crosses the border without stopping.
includes: Document review before loading
CPIC and MCI issuance for CAN international transport
Coordination with customs agencies at origin and destination
Management at Peru, Ecuador and Colombia border crossings
Follow-up on cargo release
Guidance on regimes and requirements per goods type
body: The border is where international shipments are won or lost. One badly issued document can cost days of waiting with the unit stopped.
We operate under Decision 399 of the Andean Community and review your documentation before loading, so the crossing is a formality, not a problem.

faq.q: What documents do I need to ship cargo to Ecuador or Colombia?
faq.a: Commercial invoice, packing list and the international transport documents CPIC and MCI, which we issue as an authorized carrier. Depending on the goods, additional permits may apply.

faq.q: Do you handle customs or do I need my own agency?
faq.a: We coordinate the full process. If you already work with a customs agency, we integrate with it; if not, we manage everything.

items.lead: From the moment the unit leaves origin until it unloads at destination, you know where your cargo is and how it is doing.
includes: GPS location of the unit during the whole trip
Proactive reports at route milestones
Early alerts on detours or delays
Direct line to the operations team
Delivery confirmation with evidence
body: Silence is the most expensive thing in logistics: not knowing where the cargo is forces you to chase your provider. We flip the equation and report at every milestone.
Every trip has defined milestones and you receive confirmation of each one, down to the final proof of delivery.

faq.q: How do I receive trip reports?
faq.a: By WhatsApp or email, as you prefer: updates at each milestone and delivery confirmation with evidence.
No. Cargo tracking is part of the service on every trip we run.

process.title: How your cargo travels
process.lead: Five stages, one accountable partner. The same method on every trip, national or international.

steps.title: Planning
steps.text: Together we define the route, the unit, the timeline and the documentation. The rate you approve already contains the full operation.

steps.title: Verification at origin
steps.text: We visit the loading point free of charge to confirm the goods are ready, properly packed and match what was declared.

steps.title: Insured loading
steps.text: We supervise stowage and lashing, activate the policy and the unit departs with the cargo covered from the first meter.

steps.title: In-route monitoring
steps.text: We track the unit throughout the journey and report progress to you. If anything comes up, we act first.

steps.title: Delivery at destination
steps.text: We coordinate unloading and confirm delivery with evidence at the destination point.

verification.title: Before loading, we go verify.
verification.text: It is the stage almost nobody offers and the one that prevents the most problems: before dispatching the unit, we visit the point where your cargo sits, free of charge, to confirm it is ready. No surprises at loading, no false freights, no lost days.
verification.point1: Free verification visit at the origin point
verification.point2: Packing, weights and access confirmed before the trip
verification.point3: The unit arrives when the cargo is actually ready

items.q: Do you transport cargo between Peru, Ecuador and Colombia?
items.a: Yes. We are a carrier authorized by the Andean Community and we run the corridors between Peru, Ecuador and Colombia under Decision 399, in addition to covering routes throughout Peru.

items.q: What documents do I need for international road freight?
items.a: CAN international transport requires the International Road Transport Waybill (CPIC) and the International Cargo Manifest (MCI), plus the commercial invoice and packing list. We issue and manage that documentation.
Yes. Every load travels with an active policy from loading at origin until unloading at destination. The insurance premium is quoted separately from the freight and is a client cost.

items.q: Can you pick up cargo at my plant or warehouse?
items.a: Yes, the service is door to door. Before dispatching the unit we also visit your loading point free of charge to verify the goods are ready and avoid false freights.

items.q: How long does a shipment from Lima to Bogotá take?
items.a: As a reference, between 5 and 8 days depending on cargo type, route and border crossing. During planning we confirm a committed timeline for your specific shipment.

items.q: How do I get a quote?
items.a: Message us on WhatsApp at +51 938 192 665 with origin, destination, cargo type, approximate weight and estimated date. We reply the same day with a complete proposal.

about.lead: Tránsito Nacional exists because we know this industry from the inside: decades coordinating cargo, units and borders along the Andean corridor.
story: Before it had a name of its own, our team was already moving cargo along the corridors of Peru and the Andean Community. Years of real operations taught us where time gets lost, where goods get damaged and what separates a delivered freight from a broken promise.

With that experience we built Tránsito Nacional: an operator that takes full responsibility for the trip, from planning and verification at origin to unloading at destination, with the cargo always insured and monitored.

Today we connect Peru, Ecuador and Colombia as a carrier authorized by the Andean Community, with a network of units and partners that lets us assign the right equipment for every type of cargo, on every route.
